body.purpose: List rows, menu items, buttons and editor chrome — 13px Helvetica.

label.purpose: Field text, secondary rows and metadata — 12px Helvetica.

section-label.purpose: Sidebar section headers in sentence case — 11px, 600, 0.04em, tertiary ink.

code.purpose: Only where code or a command is read: editor, terminal, diffs, tool commands.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers, dropdowns and modals (--shadow-1); the light theme uses a softer black.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover/selection washes, field focus rings and NavRail pills — state only, no decoration.

components.name: List Row
components.description: A file-tree or sidebar row: inset, rounded, ink wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-list-row { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 26px; margin: 0 6px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: rgba(245,245,247,0.82); transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-list-row:hover { background: rgba(245,245,247,0.06); color: #f5f5f7; } .ds-list-row-label { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

components.name: List Row (Selected)
components.description: A row in its selected state — a 12% ink wash, never an inverted fill.
components.css: .ds-list-row-active { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 26px; margin: 0 6px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(245,245,247,0.12); font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #f5f5f7; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one prominent action on a surface — solid ink, ground-coloured label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 8px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #f5f5f7; color: #0b0b0c; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d4d4d6; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { padding: 8px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #a1a1a6; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(245,245,247,0.07); color: #f5f5f7; }

components.name: Hover Icon Button
components.description: A row or toolbar action — 28px hit box, soft rounded wash on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" title="New file" aria-label="New file"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #a1a1a6; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: rgba(245,245,247,0.08); color: #f5f5f7; } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(245,245,247,0.55); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Every typed field, search box and dropdown trigger.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 8px; background: #161617; color: #f5f5f7; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; outline: none; transition: border-color 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #7c7c82; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.16); } .ds-field:focus { border-color: rgba(245,245,247,0.45); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(245,245,247,0.1); }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: A sidebar section header, in sentence case.
components.css: .ds-section-label { font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #7c7c82; }

narrative.overview: Sleipnir is a precision tool finished to the level of Apple's and Google's own software: neutral black and white, one Helvetica voice, soft 8px controls, and nothing on screen that is there for show. The chrome recedes so the work leads. It replaced the retired Tactical HUD look — no monospace chrome, no ALL-CAPS, no wide tracking.
keyCharacteristics: Pure neutral greys; colour only where it carries status meaning
Helvetica Neue for all UI, pinned per weight; mono only for code
Hover and selection as quiet ink washes

rules.name: The Ink-Wash Rule
rules.body: Interactive states are the theme's ink at low alpha: 6-8% hover, 12% selected.

rules.name: The One Prominent Action Rule
rules.body: The primary button is solid ink with ground-coloured text, one per surface.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: No label is set in ALL-CAPS, by string or text-transform; acronyms and file names keep their own case.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Code Rule
rules.body: Monospace only where code or a command is read.

dos: Do use var(--font-ui) for UI text and var(--font-mono) only for code
Do write labels in sentence case
Do express hover and selection as ink washes from --item-ink
Do keep controls at --radius-control and floating surfaces at --radius-float
Do give every icon button a 28px hit box
donts: Don't set any label in ALL-CAPS or add text-transform: uppercase
Don't use monospace as a technical costume for chrome
Don't invert a row to a solid ink fill for selection, or outline it on hover
Don't add hue to the neutral ramp or a third border weight
